files.dynamic_review_note: R71: exact source review; reflection targets unchanged. Existing fetch, settlement and analysis owners retained; history fallback uses the existing backfill handler; UI state reads are bounded and indexed. No numerical function or authorization change. R77: Batch unchanged runtime status fields into one existing coordinated SQLite transaction. No reflection targets or numerical values change.

review_notes.NUMERIC: All non-excluded program/feature/trainer/serializer/schema/scheduler/registry inputs are deliberately conservatively included.
review_notes.PRESENTATION: Reviewed read/render/export roots and XML presentation. Numerical path additions require explicit reclassification; no automatic glob exclusion.
review_notes.PROVENANCE: Generated release/source identities and host lifecycle diagnostic history. DB/game/runtime fields are separately bound.
review_notes.dynamic_loading: Every numeric reflection/loading source has byte-pinned review; changes fail closed until reviewed again.
review_notes.policy: Policy is separately hashed and frozen per experiment; changing a threshold does not change DEV math.
